message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Defendant Yang used false information to apply for a credit card, with help of others, knowing no income, no repayment ability, paying high fees, then maliciously overdrew 49,971.97 RMB. The application used false info, making collection impossible. He was arrested, confessed. He used credit card fraud with intent to illegally possess money, amount large. So crimes: Credit card fraud (信用卡诈骗罪) under Chinese criminal law, which is a type of fraud. Also possibly "诈骗罪" (fraud) specifically "信用卡诈骗罪". Also "伪造、变造金融票据罪"? No, using false info to apply for credit card is "提供虚假信息申请信用卡" which is part of credit card fraud. Also "非法占有" indicates fraud. Could also be "非法获取金融机构信用卡" maybe "非法获取信用卡信息罪"? But the main is "信用卡诈骗罪". Also possibly "伪造、变造金融票据罪"? Not exactly. The fact mentions "以支付高额手续费的方式" maybe "非法获取信用卡" but still fraud.

Thus likely only one crime: 信用卡诈骗罪. In Chinese law, the crime is "信用卡诈骗罪" which is a specific type of fraud. So answer: [罪名]信用卡诈骗罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: The assistance from Liu may be "帮助诈骗" but not in this part. The fact mentions "使用虚假信息" which could be "提供虚假信息罪"? There's a crime "提供虚假信息罪" under the Criminal Law? Actually there is "提供虚假信息罪" under the "刑法" article 311? Not sure. Usually false statements to banks for credit card is covered under credit card fraud. So just that.

Thus final answer.
